rag_evidence_chunks.summary: Two healthcare professionals (Surgeon #101 and Doctor #102) in operating room setup. High-confidence detections of Surgical Masks (99.1%), Surgical Caps (98.4%), Safety Goggles (96.2%), sterile Surgical Gowns (98.7%), and nitrile Medical Gloves (97.5%) while analyzing vitals telemetry.
rag_evidence_chunks.compliance_status: All active personnel fully compliant with OR sterile PPE protocol

rag_evidence_chunks.summary: Three healthcare workers in motion in ICU corridor. Lead Doctor #202 detected with full-coverage Clear Face Shield (99.5%), Surgical Mask (99.2%), Surgical Cap (99.3%), yellow Isolation Gown (99.4%), and purple Medical Gloves (98.4%). Accompanying staff (Physician #201 and Clinician #203) verified with masks, gowns, and caps.
rag_evidence_chunks.compliance_status: Face shield & droplet precaution protocol verified

rag_evidence_chunks.summary: Surgical ante-room preparation. Surgeon #301 accessing sterile storage cabinet wearing Surgical Gown (99.3%), Surgical Mask (98.4%), and Cap (98.9%). Doctor #302 actively donning bright blue sterile nitrile Medical Gloves (98.7%) while wearing Safety Goggles (97.4%) and Surgical Mask (99.1%).
rag_evidence_chunks.compliance_status: Gowning procedure verified, hand hygiene and sterile barrier in progress

rag_evidence_chunks.summary: Direct patient care setting. Physician #401 communicating patient telemetry while wearing Clear Face Shield (99.6%), Surgical Mask (99.3%), Surgical Cap (99.1%), Surgical Gown (99.5%), and Medical Gloves (98.9%). Nurse #402 consulting notes with Bouffant Cap (99.4%), Surgical Mask (98.8%), yellow Isolation Gown (99.1%), and blue Gloves (98.3%).
